name: Indian State Net-Metering and Net-Billing Regulatory Limits
source: State Electricity Regulatory Commission (SERC) Solar Rooftop Regulations and Central Electricity Authority (CEA) Technical Standards as checked on 2026-10-23.

rules.statedAs: State-specific net-metering capacity limits as percentage of sanctioned connected load and distribution transformer ceiling.
notes: In Karnataka, net-metering is restricted to 10 kW for domestic LT consumers; gross-metering applies above 10 kW.
In Delhi under Delhi Solar Policy 2024, net-metering is permitted up to 500 kW without capacity penalty.
In Gujarat, net-metering is supported with surplus energy credited at Rs. 2.25/kWh.
